title: A2UI Client Catalog
description: The client owns this. The agent names a registered component and supplies validated props; it cannot ship markup, code, or a new component. Per ADR-UI-1, catalog components ride inside the frozen ContentBlock union as artifact blocks.

catalogVersion.description: Rendered in every surface's provenance strip so the operator can see which catalog composed a block.

id.description: Group A is projection (8), Group B is resolution (4). Adding an id is a registry entry plus a component plus a schema — never a ContentBlock variant.

version.description: Bumped by any prop change that is not backward compatible.

props.description: JSON Schema for this component's props. The generated validator rejects malformed props into MalformedSurface; it never throws into the tree and never silently drops the block.

states.description: All six are renderable. A component that can only draw the happy path is unfinished.

emits.description: Actions route upward. No component invokes, fetches, listens, routes a provider, or decides policy.

resolvesFromStore.description: Fields the component resolves live rather than trusting the agent's serialized value. ServiceRow resolves status this way: an asserted status is stale the moment it was serialized.

a11y.description: The component-specific requirements that a generic pass misses.

textSummaryRequired.description: True where the visual encoding is invisible to a screen reader, e.g. MetricSpark's bar row.
